description: Segment a brain MRI of any contrast or resolution into the 32 SynthSeg 2.0 FreeSurfer labels (1 mm grid), using Neurodesk's native synthseg CLI when installed, otherwise the Neurodesk SynthSeg web app (WebGPU) through the Neurodesk Webapps desktop suite. Expects a full-head image. The web app refuses volumes whose padded 1 mm grid exceeds about 7.4 million voxels (2 GiB GPU buffer); the adapter checks that before starting it.

mode.description: default: flip averaging and topological correction (reference output); fast: single pass.

report.description: Run report: settings, model checksum, geometry, timings.

neuroflow/launch.description: Fills extensions["neurodesk/job"] from the session inputs and runs neurodesk-webapps --job; maps the label map and report downloads to outputs.

preflight.label: SynthSeg
preflight.advice: Use the native synthseg CLI (on PATH or via NEURODESK_SYNTHSEG), or a smaller field of view.
preflight.source: inference worker of neurodesk/webapps apps/synthseg (suite 0.14.20260923): the padded 1 mm grid times the widest U-Net activation (72 float32 channels = 288 bytes per voxel) must fit the validated 2 GiB (2^31-1 bytes) WebGPU buffer

fixups.reason: suite 0.14.20260923 wires the labels Download button twice (result-list handler plus saveBtn.onclick), so one click downloads the file twice and the job runner rejects the duplicate

neurodesk/job.source: neurodesk/webapps apps/synthseg; steps follow its e2e/fixture.spec.js flow

native.source: neurodesk/webapps exes/synthseg (native SynthSeg 2.0, Metal on Apple silicon); same model as the web app

useWhen: Segment a brain MRI of any contrast or resolution into the SynthSeg 2.0 FreeSurfer labels.
A next step needs a label map, e.g. per-structure volumes with label-volumes.

avoidWhen.when: You only need a brain mask or a skull-stripped image.
Only the web app is available and the image is large: it refuses grids above about 7.4 million voxels at 1 mm.

preconditions: Neurodesk's native synthseg CLI (/usr/local/bin/synthseg or NEURODESK_SYNTHSEG), or else the Neurodesk Webapps suite.
effects: Writes the label map (FreeSurfer label ids, 1 mm grid) and a JSON run report to the output directory.
mode fast skips flip averaging and topological correction.

duration.basis: Measured from the run report over 14 gallery runs with the native CLI on an Apple-silicon Mac: 4-9 s for a 1 mm T1. The web app is not measured.

failures.meaning: The image is too large for the SynthSeg web app, so it was not started.
failures.remedy: Install Neurodesk's native synthseg CLI, or crop the image; the message gives the voxel limit.

failures.meaning: The Neurodesk Webapps desktop suite is not installed.
failures.remedy: Install it from the webapps-v* releases of github.com/neurodesk/webapps, or set NEURODESK_WEBAPPS. NeurodeskApp.app is a different product and does not work here.

failures.meaning: The Neurodesk web app reported a failure for this input.
failures.remedy: Read the reported message and the job file it names; fix the input or settings it points to.

failures.meaning: The native synthseg CLI failed on this image.
failures.remedy: Read the step log, and check that t1 is a readable NIfTI with neuroflow_inspect.
